John Ricker dba BrightNest Painting was subcontracted for Lauren Walraven to refinish this play-set for her client. Prior to our arrival I know Lauren and her team at HomeOver, replaced the roofing and all fixtures involved with that and the gutters. It looks fantastic by the way!! She was a fantastic General Contractor, who cared for her clients, her subcontractors, and stood by her word.
Best GC in our play book! I look forward to working with her again, if you’re in need of anything roofing p

I can’t find enough words to express my appreciation for the amazing service I received from Brittani Parish at Homeover Contractors! My insurance company did not want to approve a new roof that I clearly needed. Brittani worked so hard to ensure that we won the claim, explaining the process clearly every step of the way. She was confident we would prevail and after two denials and going to the demand for appraisal, the full amount was approved. This company is great to work with and so professi

I am very happy with this company.  I called my insurance to filed a claim and was denied for a roof replacement due to hail damage.  Brittani (the project manager) came and helped us from A to Z. I ended up getting a brand new roof replacement approved and replaced with in 6 weeks. She was very professional and helpful. I highly recommend this company!

We can't say enough about Erik, Ethan, and the crews they had to replace our hail damaged roof, gutters and screens. His services were on time with no surprises. He came out probably a half dozen times from initial assessment of damages to final acceptance to make sure everything was first rate.
Well done!

Replaced our roof after a hail storm. Veteran friendly. Great communication. Kept to the word on price and timeline. Everything is perfect. We did a new roof, new gutters, and a solar panel take off and put back on. They did all of the work scheduling all of that. Workers were friendly and clean. Great people to work with!

Actually, I met Chad on the street while he carried out other inspection in my area. But I am extremely happy with their professionalism, responsive, high quality of work. Most important is that Chad and his management worked hard for me to get the best claim to my insurance company. Follow up trouble shoot is also very responsive and all issues are solved. Full coverages, including roof, ventilation, gutter, screen, deck, aircon boxes, and fence, etc. Great job done. I am extreme happy with all

Rick at Homeover was recommended To us. Rick was great he was with us every step of the way. He made the claim process easy and painless. He handled everything with great professionalism.
The new roof and gutters look great. I’m so happy with the final product.

I chose HomeOver General Contractors because of Blaine of there Project Managers. He was persistent in keeping in touch with me at least once a week after they inspected and gave me an estimate on the roof repair. I had mentioned to Blaine that I had gotten another estimate on the roof repair also. The other roofing companies Project Manager did not contact me once a week and sometimes did not respond back when I emailed him. So when I got my mortgage insurance check released to me I texted Blai

HomeOver contractors is top notch when it comes to communication. They’ll go through all of the details and options with you, help you choose a plan that works for your home, and then take care of all of the details a long the way. Eric made a very complex project easy for us!

Outstanding Service from HomeOver General Contractors!

I couldn’t be more pleased with the work HomeOver General Contractors did on my roof. From start to finish, their team was professional, efficient, and communicative. Scheduling was seamless, and they made sure everything was handled promptly without unnecessary delays.

A special shoutout to Robert his expertise, attention to detail, and commitment to quality were truly impressive. He kept me informed throughout the process, ensuring I fel

Great job on the roof, window screens, fence looks brand new now. Guys did a great job on everything. Guys took care of everything  evened help get is approved through the inspector. Thank you for the Class 4 Roof UPGRADE. We will definitely  use Brandon with  HomeOver Gerneral Contractors again.

HomeOver General Contractors did an awesome job of roofing our house this past July 4th.  They demonstrated courtesy and professionalism at every step of the process.  I highly recommend HomeOver to anyone in need of an honest contractor to roof or remodel your home!

I recently had my roof, gutters and garage door replaced by HomeOver. Ethan was great from the start. It wasn’t an easy insurance claim and he helped me through the whole process. He always had the time to explain things even though I know he was busy. He never made me feel he was in a hurry and was always there to help. Responded promptly and always arrived when he said he would. I love the work they did and feel Ethan went above and beyond expectations.
Branden was extremely helpful and present every step of the way. Made the process super simple and painless, plus the work was fantastic. Will always recommend to anyone looking to have work done.

Clayton and his crew are the best! After last summer’s hail storm, he was quick to help us get our roof and gutters replaced. They worked quickly and efficiently, and were done within the day! He did such a great job that other neighbors ended up calling him as well. Would definitely recommend ☺️
Erik did a great job replacing my roof great material great workmanship definitely a repeat customer!!!!!!!

Great experience! Ethan, our project manager has great customer service and people skills. He made sure the entire process was smooth. The crew did a great job on the roof and with clean up. Haven't found a nail in the yard yet!  Eric, who led the team for the interior repair work, was very pleasant and professional his crew did great work on our ceiling repair. I highly recommend HomeOver!

Brandon from HomeOver saved us during a home purchase. A home inspector botched the roof inspection and we got a second opinion from HomeOver, who let us know we definitely needed a new roof. Their quote was way better than other companies, came backed with a warranty, and saved us money during the home purchase and with our insurance. 10/10 would recommend for all your needs!

Home Over did an excellent job replacing our roof. Clay was professional and walked us through the process making the experience smooth and actually enjoyable! He recommended a company to work on our  fence. Great recommendation, Derick was great to work with!

HomeOver General Contractors is an excellent company and owned by not only knowledgeable contractors, but honest, professional and kind.  My experience was smooth, I was pleased with the results and they went over and above to ensure my property needs were met. Definitely will use them again and highly recommend the company.

So, back in April 2024 we discovered a roof leak.  UGH!!!! Right!!!!  However, Bryan came out and inspected our roof and found a few things he could repair to get us through the upcoming storms.  Insurance came through and Bryan with HomeOver General Contractors came out and put on a new roof.  The roof looks amazing, and they did an impressive job cleaning up afterwards.  I saw them getting magnets and go through the yard to make sure all roofing materials were gone.  I will have to say I am im

The night the storm peeled back our metal roof, Homeover was there throwing on a tarp to minimize the damage. Every process along the way, they made it simple and professional. I would highly recommend them for your roofing needs.

Homeover General contractors were very easy to work with and walked you through every step of the process. Ethan was knowledgeable and I didn’t have to worry about anything with getting our roof replaced after the storm. Highly recommend.

Ethan Schmidt with Homeover General Contractors was extremely helpful and knowledgeable on processing the storm claim on my behalf and for Judy Cornish of Fort Worth on her property. We are extremely pleased on the negotiation they did with our respective  insurance companies and the favorable outcome.  We wouldn't hesitate to use their firm again if the occasion demanded it.  We would highly recommend the firm to others we know.
Clayton and his crew are a great team. They take care of every detail and their service is impeccable. Strongly recommend them. Do you want to do it right? pick HomeOver General Contractors!

Our family just had a phenomenal experience with Homeover General Contractors. The company came highly recommended by my neighbors and they did not disappoint. Ethan Schmidt served as our general contractor and did an exceptional job. Easy process & great work. I highly recommend using this company.

We were blasted by a hailstorm last spring and HomeOver did an excellent job of restoring our roof and gutters.  With an A+ rating on Better Business Bureau, I felt confident using them.  They worked with our insurance to make sure we had everything we needed, and more.  Their workers were efficient, respectful and cleaned up well when they were finished.  I recommend them to anyone looking for any kind of service to the exterior of their house.  Definitely 5 stars.

We used HomeOver General Contractors to replace our roof from the big hail storm that hit in May 2023 and they did a great job.  They (Matt especially) were very communicative throughout the process.  We started the process in August and they finished the repairs in September.  They worked closely with our insurance company and tried to get back the correct amount to cover the damages.  It was a very smooth process all around and I would highly recommend them.  If needed, we will certainly use t

Outstanding experience from start to finish.
Tina was attentive & patiently answered all my questions. She kept me informed throughout the whole project. I truly appreciate the professional and promptness. I highly recommend Homeover Contractors.

We were hit by a large hail storm this past May.  Brandon came by and gave me an inspection and confirmed roof was in need of complete replacement.  I didn’t know anything about HomeOver so I checked his reviews   Finding out he was good I chose him over 20-30 other people that came by. Four of my neighbors used him since they saw the great job they did on my house. In the future, I will always use this Company.
We worked with Robert and Clayton and I can definitely recommend them to anyone that needs to have their roof replaced.  They were very professional and service was outstanding.  Very happy overall!

The crew arrived on time, and they were polite and respectful throughout the entire process. They took great care to protect my property, including my landscaping and outdoor furniture, and they left my yard spotless when they were finished.

The quality of their workmanship was outstanding, and I could tell that they really take pride in their craft. They kept me informed throughout the project, explaining each step and providing before-and-after photos to show me their progress.

Overall, I wo

Had our roof and gutters replaced as well as a broken window. They were professional and efficient. We didn't have to do much but file the initial claim and choose colors after that but they took care of everything else. I would recommend this company to anyone.
They were so easy to work with and so nice! Worked quick and excellent communication

HomeOver assigns a high number of crew to the project, so were able to finish the project (3,800 sf house) in one day. Including prep and cleanup.  We are very pleased with the professionalism, speed, and quality of the new roof.

We used HomeOver General Contractors to replace our roof in July 2023. The entire process was streamlined and handled directly by Brandon Anderson while we were away in Mexico for vacation! They were on time (ring cameras), and Brandon was very professional and always went out of his way to accommodate us. They even submitted all documentation to my insurance company for us to be able to get our depreciation check! 10/10 would highly recommend to our family and neighbors.

I had a leak which caused some drywall damage after some heavy rains a few weeks ago.  It was impossible to tell whether it was from a window or the roof.  I attempted to get various restoration and window companies to help, but they claimed they can’t  diagnose and didn’t want to guess.

After 3 days of failure, I called HomeOver Contractors the day before it was forecast to storm again (and therefore more damage).  I spoke to Tina and sent her some pictures.  She perfectly understood the urgen

We used HomeOver after the hale storm in April 2024. They put together a personal repair plan the put our house completely back together. After the hail damage was repaired we used HomeOver again to fix seals in windows and put in solar screen.

I've had the best experience with HomeOver Roofing.  They have expressed more concern with this project than any other companty I have ever used for anything.  Brandon was the best.  He explained every part of the project, kept me updated on timing and what to expect.  Came by several times to check on things.  Great job on the gutters and screens also.  He came by after to do a thorough clean up. They went over and above on the roof i.e. trimming some trees at my roof line.  I didn't even ask t

Erik Ruffing, the senior project manager from HomeOver General Contractors, has great customer service. He was very friendly to work with and was quick to respond to any questions or concerns in a timely manner. We highly recommend HomeOver to everyone!

Our insurance wanted to fight us on replacing our roof. Luckily Ethan has had plenty of experience with this and he walked us through what we needed to do and what to expect the entire way. I couldn't be more pleased with the work that was done and professionalism that it was done im. I will be recommending home over and specifically Ethan to all my clients and friends.

Hunter Tatum was very professional and friendly and made me feel like I could trust the company. Fast and professional and my roof looks great and has also been approved by the homeowners association!

Friend of mine recommended "HomeOver General Contractors". Replaced my roof with this company. Jeremy Craige (Contractor) was exceptional from start to finish. He was extremely thorough and great service from start to the very end. They definitely are a great company and I would recommend them to anyone that has need of roof replacement.

From start to finish Ethan went above and beyond to make this a seamless process for us. He was extremely thorough and detailed and we had no questions go unanswered. The crew were fast and respectful of our property and our new roof looks great. We would recommend Ethan in a heartbeat.

I used HomeOver to do my roof replacement  this past summer and they did an excellent job.  I had at least half a dozen roof companies out to interview before I chose HomeOver and I'm glad I did; they were honest about the process, kept me informed about where things were with the insurance company, and followed through on all of what was promised. I can recommend them highly.

We were introduced to HomeOver General Contractors by a family friends. Matt Wall was assigned to us, and we were really impressed with his services right from the consultation till the end of the job. Matt constantly kept in touch with us as well as with the insurance company explaining each item that needed repair or replacement. We were extremely happy with the work that was carried out and would not hesitate to use them for our future projects or recommend to a friend. .

We had a great experience with HomeOver.  From the initial consult until the finished product, Cameron worked with us seamlessly to make sure that we received a great roof and fence which needed to be replaced from hail damage.  He even worked with our insurance company for full reimbursement.
These contractors were efficient, professional and extremely expedient. I was very pleased with my new black roof. It most definitely gave my home a fresh new look. Thank you so much!

We had nothing but a great experience with homeover! From the first meeting until the last, we had an easy and pleasant experience. The owner is such a nice guy and very upfront. We would definitely recommend!
